description:
Open the full report of a crypto wallet check: why it got its verdict, and the paths of funds behind it.

A crypto wallet address is checked as an address, never as a name. The
report belongs to a check crypto_wallet_screen made (`check_id`) and
answers `report` (`why`, `paths`, `decision`, `score_lines`, `read`,
`paths_note`), `pdf_url` and the `wallet` verdict block.

`report.paths` is empty when nothing that was read came from or went to
a listed or risky source within 2 hops; `report.paths_note` then says so
with what was read (`report.read`: transfers, period, USD in and out).
An empty `paths` means "no transfers" only when `report.read.transfers`
is 0.

Opening a report is paid from the account's plan or its credits. When
opening would spend a credit and `confirm` is not true, nothing is
opened or spent: the answer carries `needs_confirmation: true`, the
`price` and its `price_line`. Tell the user the price, and call again
with confirm=true only once they agree. A report already opened is read
again at no charge.

Examples:
  crypto_wallet_report("01JD8Q7T6XK3M5N9P2R4S6V8W0")
  crypto_wallet_report("01JD8Q7T6XK3M5N9P2R4S6V8W0", confirm=True)

api_key.description: Your Ohmyfin API key (prod-...). Optional here: it can be sent instead as a KEY header or an Authorization: Bearer header. What the tool requires of the key is in its description.

confirm.description: Set true only after the user has agreed to the price this tool stated for opening the report. Default false: nothing is spent.

name: crypto_wallet_report
title: Crypto Wallet Full Report
